units: Unity meters / seconds; pitch plane is XZ

physic_material_soccer.note: Raw Soccer material bounciness is 0.4. Boundary wall colliders have no material (Unity default, bounciness 0.0); BounceCombine Average gives effective boundary restitution e=0.2. All audited field/boundary BoxColliders have m_Material path_id 0, so Unity's default dynamic friction 0.6 is inferred for the surface; Average friction combine gives effective ground and boundary contact friction 0.35. Boundary collision friction removes tangential velocity up to mu*(1+e)*normal_speed. No serialized runtime drag was found.

friction_model.formula: Fit v(t) = v0 - a*t to clean runtime deceleration windows; a = 5.95 m/s^2; t_stop = |v|/a; s_stop = |v|^2/(2a)
friction_model.inference_note: The asset-material estimate (0.35*g = 3.4335 m/s^2) underestimates the observed runtime slowdown. Clean monotonic free-ball windows in timeplot_2026-07-21_13-11-46.json fit a median deceleration of 5.95 m/s^2 (p25–p75 ≈ 5.95–5.96). Equivalent mu≈0.607 at g=9.81. Used by both the offline simulator and Titanium trajectory service. Independent community report (MerijnZ1) of rolling resistance ≈6 u/s^2 matches within ~1%.

calibration.method: Least-squares linear fits over clean monotonic speed-decay windows; median fitted slope magnitude.

players.note: Reachability ≈ circle radius growing with max speed (Apollonius / earliest-intercept). No Coulomb player friction; controller-driven.
players.tackle: Deduct min(attacker,carrier) stamina from both; survivor with stamina>0 keeps/wins ball (near-ball interact, not body hitbox alone)
players.interact: Near the ball (Player Interact Radius), not only player collider
players.free_ball_pickup: Not automatic — must interact/tackle to claim a loose ball (AIA 2026-07-19)
players.shot_charge: Hold SoccerController Bool2 (interact) to charge; set false to release kick in that frame's move direction

drive_pdf.what_it_is: ORYX Survival competition code writeup (state machine / sprint-at-70%-stamina policy). Not a Soccer or Survival physics dump — no accel/friction numbers.

survival_movement_similarity.soccer_status: Controller shape matches (SoccerController moveTo/sprint/interact). Soccer walk/sprint speeds and accel still unconfirmed; Titanium still uses 4.5/2.5 interception defaults.

notes.low_speed_threshold: Numerical stop policy only. Speeds at or below this threshold stop without integrating the residual distance, whose bound is threshold^2/(2*accel).
notes.max_free_ball_speed: Safety cap on free-ball predictor input only. Raised to 80 m/s from timeplot_2026-07-21_13-59-01.json (p99 free/kick speeds ~75, impulse spikes higher). Not an audited Soccer prefab value.
notes.event_time_epsilon: Tolerance for accepting a quadratic event root at the friction stop boundary and for grouping simultaneous corner contacts.
notes.held_carrier_lookahead: Bounded prediction horizon for opponent-held-ball interception; not a scraped runtime physics constant.

player_movement_calibration.evidence_policy: SoccerController exposes sprint, move target, and interact inputs, but the available Soccer assets do not expose auditable movement speed or acceleration floats. Community: players are perfect simple movers (geometric reach circles). Do not treat opaque prefab values as confirmed.
player_movement_calibration.model: accelerate_then_cruise_toward_moveTo (simple mover); sprint bool raises max speed when stamina allows

interception_defaults.source: Opaque Soccer prefab candidate values; not verified against the runtime prefab. Used by Titanium ReachTime until remeasured.

soccer_get_float_marks.axis_convention: Depth ≈ long axis toward goals (our ±X); Width ≈ sideline axis (our ±Z). Width 50 ≈ ball-center Z span 49.4; Depth 80 ≈ post span 80.4 / playable X span 79.
soccer_get_float_marks.note: These are the runtime SoccerGetFloat constants. Ball-center collision AABB below is tighter by ~ball radius / wall thickness.

goal.rule: End walls collide EXCEPT |z|<=6 goal mouths — ball passes through and terminates (no bounce). Upright posts are solid vertical capsules at (±40.2, ±6) with world radius 0.3 (parent scale 0.6 × local capsule 0.5); ball-center contact radius = post_r + ball_r ≈ 0.706. Geometry behind the goal line (nets) is ignored — scoring terminates the free-ball path.

post_bounce.note: Grazing endline-rail hits have tiny geometric vn; PhysX still scrapes the ball inward hard (timeplot_2026-07-21_12-59-35 ~t=8.63: (0,-28.8)->(-11.7,-16.0)). Floor |vn| to graze_vn_floor_frac*|v| and kill at least scrape_tangent_frac*|v| of tangential speed.

goal.post_evidence: level0 CapsuleCollider on LeftPost/RightPost; timeplot_2026-07-21_12-36-34 ~t=9.42 and 12-59-35 ~t=8.63 endline scrapes.

walls.endlines_in_mouth: OPEN — pass through / score (terminal), never bounce

slide_into_wall_absorb.note: Tiny into-wall velocity while already on a solid wall is absorbed (vx/vz->0) so the predictor does not invent a bounce that then misses the post. Real wall shots with meaningful |vn| still bounce.

walls.goal_posts: XZ circles; e=0.2 + graze floor/scrape (see goal.post_bounce)
